_about: Hostile and notable mobs: health, threat and how to counter them. Damage values are on Normal difficulty and can differ by version; the game's own attributes are used for calculations where available.

zombie.counter: Hit and back off; burns in daylight unless wearing a helmet. Calls nearby zombies for help.

skeleton.counter: Close in from cover or zigzag; shields block arrows. Burns in daylight.

creeper.threat: explodes 1.5 s after getting within about 3 blocks (bigger if charged by lightning)
creeper.counter: Hit it to knock it back, then step away; it stops if you're over ~7 blocks away. A shield reduces the blast. Cats and ocelots scare it.

spider.threat: melee, climbs walls, neutral in daylight
spider.counter: Fight on open ground; cave spiders poison.

enderman.threat: teleports, hits hard; neutral unless you look at its head
enderman.counter: Avoid eye contact or wear a carved pumpkin; stand under a 2-block-high roof (it's 3 tall); water hurts it; arrows teleport away from it.

witch.threat: throws harmful potions and heals itself

slime.counter: Spawns in slime chunks below Y 40 and swamps at night.

phantom.threat: dives from the sky if you haven't slept for 3+ days
phantom.counter: Sleep; fight with a bow or time melee hits as it swoops.

pillager.threat: crossbows; part of raids and outposts

evoker.threat: fangs and vexes; drops a totem
evoker.counter: Rush it before vexes pile up.

ravager.threat: very strong melee and knockback in raids
ravager.counter: Ranged from high ground, or a shield to stun it.

guardian.threat: laser beam; elder guardians cause Mining Fatigue
guardian.counter: Break line of sight; drink milk to clear Mining Fatigue.

blaze.threat: fireballs from range, flies; spawns at spawners in fortresses
blaze.counter: Fire Resistance; snowballs hurt it; fight at its spawner around corners.

ghast.counter: Hit fireballs back at it; bow.

wither_skeleton.threat: Wither effect on hit; spawns in fortresses
wither_skeleton.counter: Fight in 2-block-high spaces (it's 2.4 tall and can't follow); source of wither skulls.

piglin.threat: attacks unless you wear a gold armour piece; angry if you open chests or mine gold near it
piglin.counter: Wear gold; barter by giving gold ingots.

piglin_brute.threat: always hostile in bastions, heavy axe

hoglin.counter: Scared of warped fungus, portals and respawn anchors; drops pork.

zombified_piglin.threat: neutral; the whole group attacks if one is hit
zombified_piglin.counter: Don't hit them unless farming; used for gold farms.

shulker.counter: Shield or hit the bullets; drops shells for shulker boxes.

warden.threat: extremely strong melee and a sonic boom that ignores armour; senses vibrations and smell, is blind
warden.counter: Avoid: sneak (no vibrations), throw snowballs or arrows to distract, place wool to dampen sounds, don't trigger sculk shriekers (3 shrieks summon it).

breeze.threat: wind charges that knock back; trial chambers
breeze.counter: Melee when it lands; drops breeze rods for wind charges and the mace.

ender_dragon.counter: Destroy the end crystals on the pillars first (some are caged), then hit it when it perches; beds explode in the End for big damage.

wither.threat: explosive skulls, Wither effect, breaks blocks
wither.counter: Fight underground or in an enclosed space; Smite, Strength and healing; at half health it becomes immune to arrows.
